name: Bel
overview: Bel is identified in Scripture as a Babylonian god whose idols are powerless and subject to judgment. Isaiah 46:1 describes Bel bowing down, burdened and unable to sustain himself, symbolizing the futility of idol worship. Jeremiah 50:2 and 51:44 further affirm that Bel will be confounded and punished, with Babylon’s idols broken and the city’s defenses falling, demonstrating God's sovereignty over false gods and the ultimate defeat of Babylon’s idolatry.
